note: The pipeline by iteration, in the order the artefacts were hashed. No run dates (thesis rule). Hash prefixes are config_sha256 values from the run log and thesis ch4.

nodes.title: Baseline configuration
nodes.changed: The first index-and-configuration manifest. Router and k_graph were still placeholders.
nodes.why: Every run must name one hashed manifest, so I0 fixed the starting point.
nodes.evidence: Kept as the baseline only; it refers to the first graph snapshot.

nodes.title: Prerequisite edges audited
nodes.changed: A judge pass rebuilt the prerequisite edges, which made a new graph snapshot.
nodes.why: A blinded audit found too many wrong PREREQUISITE_OF edges for the walk to rely on.
nodes.evidence: Everything written against the old snapshot was marked superseded in place; nothing was deleted.

nodes.title: Configuration on the judged graph
nodes.changed: New graph snapshot; Sonnet 5.5 became the only answer model.
nodes.why: The graph changed, so the manifest that binds it had to change.
nodes.evidence: Superseded when the restored prerequisite edges produced a third snapshot.

nodes.title: Final graph, first pilot
nodes.changed: The final graph after the restore. Strata, gold and the 30 pilot items were locked against it.
nodes.why: This is the configuration the first pilot tested end to end.
nodes.evidence: Tagger agreement on the bank: kappa 0.33 exact stratum, 0.20 primary membership.

nodes.title: Pilot 1 runs
nodes.changed: Nothing in the design yet: the pilot is the test of the design.
nodes.why: Run the real harness on a small slice before any main-pool item is answered.
nodes.evidence: L 28/30, R 10/30, H 12/30, Hc 11/30 fully correct (descriptive). Arm G was still building.

nodes.title: Post-mortem
nodes.changed: Five design defects found and seven decisions (U1 to U7) put to the author; record corrected.
nodes.why: Fix what failed before pilot 2, and say which artefacts stay valid.
nodes.evidence: Two consultants refuted the draft; its claims that the prompt was the main cause and that gate 3 failed were withdrawn or corrected.

nodes.title: Prompt, router and dev tuning
nodes.changed: New answer prompt P2, scope line, gold-citation proxy, new T10, gate 3 restated, dev set of 45 items; R and the router tuned on dev.
nodes.why: Each fix answers one post-mortem defect, fixed and hashed before the data it governs.
nodes.evidence: P2 abstained on 1/12 gold-present cells against 5/12 for P0. The 9 router configurations tied at 77/216; the tie rule chose s7-b/2, k_graph 10.

nodes.title: Configuration after Addendum C
nodes.changed: Hashes P2, the router table, k_graph, T10, the judge request parameters and a committed core.
nodes.why: Everything pilot 1 found loose is now inside the hash.
nodes.evidence: Superseded by I4 before any pilot ran under it.

nodes.title: Hop-0 crowding found
nodes.changed: Nothing yet: a recount of pilot 1's retrieval showed the graph lists barely reach past the seed concepts.
nodes.why: Under rule 7, hop-0 passages fill every slot, so the relation labels cannot change H's list.
nodes.evidence: As run, 1 of 30 graph lists held a deeper-hop passage. Under I3 none would: a projection with the same seeds, not an observation.

nodes.title: Balanced rank rule and one scorer
nodes.changed: Rule 7's ordering is replaced by a per-hop quota with backfill and a fixed output order; every hop-0 to hop-2 passage gets a cross-encoder score from one scorer.
nodes.why: Give deeper hops a seat in the graph list, without reading any label.
nodes.evidence: 25/25 scoring kernels matched 200 old scores exactly; H re-tuned: a three-way tie at k_graph 30, decided by the tie rule.

nodes.title: Configuration for pilot 2 and the main run
nodes.changed: k_graph 10 → 30, graph_rank hop-balanced/1, the merged score file and the pilot-2 bank are bound.
nodes.why: One frozen configuration for everything that follows.
nodes.evidence: R keeps depth 30, rerank_top 10; I3 marked superseded in place.

nodes.title: LightRAG baseline index
nodes.changed: A clean staged rebuild of G's index.
nodes.why: The first full build stopped at Kaggle's 12 h limit at merge stage 289 of 394, with no valid index.
nodes.evidence: G's index will be one recorded instance with its hash; LightRAG's merge order is not deterministic.

nodes.title: Pilot 2
nodes.changed: Same 30 items, all five arms, L × 3, G × 1, under I4.
nodes.why: The protocol's own loop: gate 1 is open (G missing) and gate 2 failed, so the pilot reruns.
nodes.evidence: Gate 3 is evaluated once, here. No result exists to show.
